content.text:
61 tests, two consecutive clean runs (~11s). Final layout:

```
tests/
  helpers/todo-app.ts          page object + localStorage seeding helper
  adding-todos.spec.ts         (9)
  editing-todos.spec.ts        (11)
  completing-todos.spec.ts     (9)
  deleting-todos.spec.ts       (10)
  filtering.spec.ts            (16)
  app-shell-and-persistence.spec.ts (8)
```

I explored the live app with the MCP browser tools before writing anything, and several tests encode behaviors that differ from the usual TodoMVC assumptions: a whitespace-only submit is rejected **without** clearing the input (the typed spaces stay), titles are trimmed on both add and edit, clearing a todo's text during an edit deletes it rather than saving an empty title, blurring the edit box **saves** (only Escape cancels), the per-row delete button is `display:none` until the row is hovered (so `getByRole('button', {name:'Delete'})` finds nothing and a bare `.click()` times out — the helper hovers first), "Mark all as complete" acts on todos hidden by the active filter, and an unrecognised hash like `#/does-not-exist` falls back to showing everything under the All filter. Coverage spans adding (ordering, duplicates, trimming, markup-as-literal-text, long titles, empty→populated chrome transition), editing (edit-mode entry/exit, Enter/Escape/blur, delete-on-empty, completed state preserved, single-edit-at-a-time), completing (individual toggles, master checkbox in both directions and its derived checked state, counter singular/plural), deleting and "Clear completed" (including the return to the empty state where `.main`/`.footer` unmount and storage becomes `[]`), filtering and hash routing (each filter's contents and `selected` class, counter independence from the filter, cross-filter mutations, deep links, back/forward), plus the app shell and `react-todos` localStorage persistence across reloads — with one test asserting the app logs no console errors beyond the demo's own favicon 404. `playwright.config.ts` is unchanged and no dependencies were added.
